note: Every defect here is a pattern that a real bench run on a real repo already found during the 2026-07-29 sessions. Nothing is invented to be findable, and nothing is invented to be missable.

defects.title: Retry backoff is computed and stored but never read
defects.mechanism: incrementRetry writes nextAttemptAt; drainQueue selects every pending entry and never consults it. Backoff exists in the data model and not in the behaviour, so a failing endpoint is hammered at full loop speed.

defects.title: Sync status reports SYNCED while failed entries remain
defects.mechanism: getSyncStatus counts pending and conflict. Entries moved to failed by markFailed are counted by neither, so a technician whose captures exhausted their retries sees SYNCED.

defects.title: Watchdog records alerted=true for a send that cannot fail
defects.mechanism: sendEmail returns Promise<void> and swallows every error including a missing API key. runWatchdog sets alerted = true purely because a recipient was configured, so the alerting record is true whether or not any mail was sent.

defects.title: RLS enabled, then a policy that grants everyone everything
defects.mechanism: ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY followed by a SELECT policy USING (true) and a GRANT to anon. RLS is on, which reads as protected, and the policy makes every row in public.reports readable by an unauthenticated caller holding the publishable key.

defects.title: Cascade delete reaches the audit log
defects.mechanism: User -> Inspection is onDelete: Cascade and Inspection -> AuditLog is onDelete: Cascade. Deleting a user destroys the audit rows that record what that user did, which is the evidence you need precisely when an account is being deleted.

defects.title: The security migration is committed and not in the ledger
defects.mechanism: 003_rls_fix.sql drops the permissive policy from 002 and revokes anon. APPLIED_LEDGER.txt lists 001 and 002 only. The repository looks fixed and the database is not — the exact shape of the 2026-07-29 ATO incident.

defects.title: The only test file matches no vitest include glob
defects.mechanism: vitest.config.ts includes lib/**/__tests__/** and app/**/__tests__/**. The test lives at repository root in __tests__/, which matches neither. The suite is green because it is empty.

defects.title: Health endpoint cannot identify the running build
defects.mechanism: version falls back to the literal "1.0.0" when NEXT_PUBLIC_APP_VERSION is unset. The endpoint answers ok and names a version that is not the deployed commit, so after a bad deploy you cannot tell from /api/health which build is live or whether a rollback took effect.
